in_marathi.name: Athit
in_marathi.long_meaning: Athit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Athit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'athita', which means 'guest' or 'visitor'. In Hindu mythology, Athit is a name for the god Indra, the king of the gods, who is known as the god of hospitality and rain.
